chapterTitle: The Alliance Strategy: Seem to Work for the Interests of Others While Furthering Your Own
coreMove: Advance your own position by designing an arrangement in which a stronger actor helps you because your success materially serves that actor's goals.
reversal: The strategy turns manipulative when the overlap is performative, invented, or so shallow that support vanishes the moment incentives diverge.
teachingEmphasis: treat alliance as interest design rather than charm
show the difference between genuine overlap and staged overlap
teach borrowed leverage without romanticizing loyalty
name the ethical boundary where alignment becomes manipulation
